messages:
Samira Khan: hey team  Samira here (she/they), excited to join Eng-ML today! Remote GMT+1. quick questions to get started: who do I ping for MDM enrollment? need access to the ML staging project and a short-lived service account for nightly evals. also curious who my buddy is. fun fact: I play tabla and will probably bring hand-drums to the first meetup. :drum:

Evan (Buddy): welcome Samira!! :tada: Im Evan, your buddy for month one. Ill DM to set a 30-min intro and a short todo list (CLA, runbook readme, small onboarding PR). Also can walk you through the staging project and notebooks.

Jordan (IT): hey Samira  MDM invite should be queued. If you dont see it, go to https://intranet.redwood/mdm-enroll and re-open Company Portal. For staging project access, open the access portal and request role `ml-staging-reader` plus `service-account-temp`. Service account requests need: `purpose`, `ttl` (max 7d), and `owner`. Example body: `purpose: nightly evals for A/B test, ttl: 3d, owner: samira.khan`. Also paste your SSH pubkey in your profile so we can provision keys: `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | pbcopy`.

Ivy (ML Infra): hi Samira  welcome! If you need GPU nodes for local perf tests we have a dev pool `gpu-queue-ix` you can request for short jobs. For nightly evals, we usually recommend the service account specify `read-only` on datasets. I can pre-approve demo creds for 24h if you want to validate the eval pipeline quickly.

Marta (People Ops): welcome Samira :balloon: welcome kit & sticker pack shipped. New-hire orientation calendar invite sent. If you prefer a linux laptop instead of the default macbook 14\", reply here and well swap. Also we run a casual instruments & snacks lunch on Friday  bring the tabla!

DevexBot: Reminder: join #eng-ml, #devex, and #ml-infra for docs and pairing slots. Onboarding checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/ml/ONBOARDING.md

Samira Khan: thanks everyone  I see the MDM invite now, Jordan. submitted the access request with note: `purpose: nightly evals, ttl: 3d, owner: samira.khan` (ticket #ML-3044). Also pasted SSH key to profile. Evan  30-min intro works after 14:00 CET. Ivy  demo creds for 24h would be perfect to smoke-test the eval job. Marta  Ill bring a small cajon + tabla for Friday :grin:

Evan (Buddy): perfect  sending calendar invite for 14:30 CET today. Ill include a short list of first-tasks so you can open a trivial PR on day 2. Looking forward to the instrument showdown. :musical_note:

Jordan (IT): noted ticket ML-3044, will provision service-account-temp pending manager sign-off.

Ivy (ML Infra): demo creds granted for 24h under ticket ML-3044. Ill DM the temporary key and a quick runbook link for the eval pipeline.

Samira Khan: brilliant, thanks everyone! Ill post a quick hello in #eng-ml and start reading the eval runbook. :rocket:
